name: Ciarán Murphy
bio: Ciarán has been with 1st Meath Dunboyne since 1994, starting as a Beaver before working his way up to Group Leader in 2015. A passionate advocate for outdoor education and youth development, he holds multiple national scouting training qualifications.

name: Siobhán O'Brien
bio: Siobhán joined as a Cub leader in 2009 and took on the Deputy Group Leader role in 2019. She coordinates training and development for all adult leaders and chairs the group's child safeguarding committee.

name: Padraig Connolly
bio: Padraig brings boundless energy and creativity to the Beaver Colony. A primary school teacher by profession, he has a natural gift for engaging young children and makes every meeting feel like the best day of the week.

name: Aoibheann Farrell
bio: Aoibheann joined as a parent helper when her daughter became a Beaver, and never left. She completed her leader training in 2021 and now leads the Colony's outdoor programme with particular enthusiasm for nature education.

name: Declan Nolan
bio: Declan has led the Cub Pack since 2013. A former Scout himself, he's passionate about camp craft and outdoor cooking, and takes great pride in the Pack's reputation for producing some of the best campfire food in Meath.

name: Roisín McCarthy
bio: Roisín holds a BSc in Outdoor Education and a Canoeing Ireland Level 2 qualification. She leads the Scout Troop with a focus on challenge and personal development, and has led groups on expeditions to Norway and the Swiss Alps.

name: Brian Walsh
bio: Brian has been a leader with 1st Meath Dunboyne for twelve years, taking on the Ventures section in 2018. He's a qualified mountain leader and has led expeditions to the Alps, the Pyrenees, and the Wicklow Mountains.

name: Karen Dunne
bio: Karen manages the group's administration, communications, and event coordination with remarkable efficiency. She's also a qualified Cub leader who steps in when needed, and coordinates all parent liaison for the group.
